label.$description: Labels, field labels, table heads, meta; chips, tabs, ages, counts, state words.

body.$description: Body text, long-form reading, title bars, and the names in rows, groups and meters.

title.$description: An editable title in a card.

pageNarrow.$description: A working screen's name on a phone.

figureNarrow.$description: A stat's value at 900px and under.

2.$description: A second-level heading in long-form reading.

3.$description: A third-level heading in long-form reading.

titleNarrow.$description: A document's title on a phone.

code.$description: A code block in long-form reading.
A secret's characters, so each reads apart.

heading.$description: First- and second-level headings in long-form reading.

default.$description: Every line: a control's or surface's border and a divider; also the 1px box of visually hidden text.

accent.$description: The accent bar beside a checked menu choice, a drop marker, a focused field's baseline or a mixed check's bar.

row.$description: The height of a row, a list item on a page or in a palette, a table row or a title bar: one control and room around it.

deck.$description: The widest a deck of panels runs.

meterName.$description: The widest a meter's name column prints.

stageNotice.$description: The widest a paused stage's notice prints.

default.$description: The column of panels beside a deck, until the reader sizes it.

drawer.$description: The rail as a drawer, whatever width the reader gave it.

folded.$description: The rail folded to its first panel's bar, stood on end.

resize.$description: The width of a rail's resize handle.

reelColumn.$description: The narrowest a reel column prints, whatever its width.

slot.$description: The narrowest a row's slot prints.

fieldGrid.$description: The narrowest a field grid's column prints.

sortableGrid.$description: The narrowest a sortable grid's item prints.

sortablePanel.$description: The narrowest a sortable panel prints.

meterName.$description: The narrowest a meter's name column prints.

reelPane.$description: The shortest a reel pane prints.

textarea.$description: The least height of a textarea.

codeSurface.$description: The least height of a code surface.

metaRow.$description: The least height of a board card's meta row.

target.$description: The least size of a pointer target, and an icon button's size.

note.$description: A note line or an empty state's text.

large.$description: A query field, a key, a check's author on a phone.

small.$description: The narrowest a query field prints.

query.$description: The widest a query field prints.

xxLarge.$description: The widest a history entry's author prints.

title.$description: A sheet title's basis, a check's author.

spinner.$description: The width and height of the spinner a busy button, chip, loading line, link state or palette row prints.

mark.$description: The check drawn in a checked box, and the width of a mixed box's bar.

large.$description: A large glyph: an outcome's, a drop zone's or a wall's.

control.$description: The height of a control: a button, a field, a select, a segmented strip, a menu item.

mark.$description: The dot inside a chosen radio.

diffLine.$description: The line height of a diff's line numbers.

boardColumnRoom.$description: What a board column leaves of the viewport's height.

markdownImage.$description: The tallest an image grows in the Markdown editor.

width.$description: A meter bar's width; it shrinks in a narrow meter.

default.$description: A monogram's height and least width: two letters at label size, with room.

large.$description: A large monogram's height and least width.

controlSmall.$description: The height of a small control: a small button, a tab, a chip or filter chip.

xxSmall.$description: The least: a hairline apart, a label's meta from its value.

xSmall.$description: Tight: a field's label above its input, a glyph in a dense line.

small.$description: Between things in one line: buttons, chips, a glyph and its word.

medium.$description: Between grouped lines, and the inline padding of a row, cell or bar.

large.$description: Between the parts of one body: a panel's, a card's, a window's.

xLarge.$description: Around an empty state, a wall or a dialog on its veil.

xxLarge.$description: The most: beside a sheet's content.

inset.$description: Inside a surface: the padding of a panel's, card's or window's body, a stat, a meter row.

gutter.$description: Between whole surfaces, and between them and the page's edge: a deck's, board's, rail's and top bar's.

small.$description: How far a focus ring sits outside its box; inside, it is drawn at the negative. Step small.

large.$description: How far a focus ring sits outside its box; inside, it is drawn at the negative. Step large.

default.$description: Beside the label of a control: a button, a field, a select, a segment.

small.$description: Beside the label of a small control: a small button, a tab, a chip.

offset.$description: How far an underline sits below the text.

toast.$description: How far a toast rises as it eases in.

control.$description: The corners of a control: a button, a chip, a field.

mark.$description: The corners of a checkbox, small enough that it never reads as a radio.

surface.$description: The corners of a surface: a panel, a card, a menu, a notice.
